name: tesco-highlight
description: Firefox/Chrome extension that highlights Tesco prices and price-per-kg as low/mid/high, including Clubcard prices.

scripts.lint: web-ext lint --source-dir=. --ignore-files research/** node_modules/** package.json package-lock.json
scripts.types:api: bunx quicktype --lang typescript --just-types --no-enums --no-date-times --top-level TescoCategoryResponse --src-lang json --out research/tesco-api.ts research/fixtures/ice-cream-api.json
scripts.types:taxonomy: bunx quicktype --lang typescript --just-types --no-enums --no-date-times --top-level TescoTaxonomyResponse --src-lang json --out research/tesco-taxonomy.ts research/fixtures/categories.json
